info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API provides a streamlined way for businesses to access the current status of retail orders. Users can query the status of specific orders, allowing for improved order management and tracking. This API is particularly beneficial for customer support teams and order fulfillment specialists who require real-time updates on order progress. By integrating this API, companies can enhance customer satisfaction through timely information delivery and reduce operational inefficiencies.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest status of their orders. It provides an overview of the order's current state, whether it's pending, shipped, delivered, or canceled.

requestBody.description: Request body to fetch the status of orders. This should include necessary identifiers or parameters as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current order status.

ListRetailOrdersStatusRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation on the orders status endpoint.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.title: Order Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the order status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the order.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the order.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the order status.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for retrieving the status of an order.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains information regarding the audit of the order status retrieval.

x-processing-time.description: The total time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed instantaneously.
